Title: Microsoft Azure Purview provides unified data governance

Body.Content:
Manage and govern data residing in your on-premises, multicloud and SaaS apps using Azure Purview. Create a unified, up to date understanding of your data landscape with automated data discovery, sensitive data classification, and end-to-end data lineage with Purview Data Map. Enable business and technical data consumers to effortlessly discover this trusted and accurate data using Purview Data Catalog. And, get a birds-eye view of data usage across your organization with Purview data insights. 

Get started.

Learn more.
